source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Atmospheric hazards
description: Disruption, or damage of satellite infrastructure as a result of atmospheric events such as electromagnetic pulses, geomagnetic disturbance, or termal radiation, as well as man-made space debris. Such developments can affect satellite systems both in the test environment and in orbit.
